text: ServiceNow, Inc. is listed on the New York Stock Exchange; per its 2026 proxy statement, the owners of more than 5% of its common stock are BlackRock, Inc. (8.8%) and The Vanguard Group, Inc. (8.7%). No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.
short: ServiceNow is NYSE-listed; BlackRock (8.8%) and Vanguard (8.7%) are its only disclosed >5% holders.

source.name: ServiceNow, Inc., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.note: SEC EDGAR filing. The 'Greater than 5% Shareholders' table is the only >5% ownership disclosure in the proxy; no other holder is listed under it.
source.quote: Greater than 5% Shareholders: BlackRock, Inc. (1) 91,252,660 8.8% The Vanguard Group, Inc. (2) 90,591,730 8.7%

additionalSources.name: ServiceNow, Inc., Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
additionalSources.note: Supports the NYSE listing stated in the claim: the 10-K cover page registers the common stock on 'The New York Stock Exchange' under the symbol NOW, and Item 5 states the sentence quoted.
additionalSources.quote: Our common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "NOW."
